CustomField.description: Lets a person run a failed call of this service again from its API issue: the Retry action, Retry Selected on the API Issues list, and the Retry API Issues flow action. Outbound: the request is sent again. Inbound: the request is read from the call and run again in your org; turn this on only when the callers of the service do not send failed requests again themselves. Retry never runs a call marked Permanent Failure, nor an inbound request the call does not hold an exact copy of. This is not the automatic retry: that is governed by Max Retry Count and Retry Backoff.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lets Retry, Retry Selected and the Retry API Issues flow action run a failed call again. Outbound: sends the request again. Inbound: runs the request kept on the call again in your org; turn it on when callers do not resend failed requests themselves. Retry never runs a call marked Permanent Failure. Automatic retries are governed by Max Retry Count and Retry Backoff instead.
CustomField.label: Retry Issues
